responsibility: Generates the AVR target’s multilib makefile fragment from the declarative MCU list. The script scans `avr-mcus.def`, derives required multilib variants from architecture, short-stack-pointer, short-call, and configured double/long-double combinations, and emits `MULTILIB_OPTIONS`, `MULTILIB_DIRNAMES`, `MULTILIB_REQUIRED`, and reuse mappings used by the GCC build system to compile the correct AVR multilib directory set.
